detail.title: 4MP+2MP WizColor Vari-focal Network PT Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-PTS2449C-4E3Z-S-PV-PRO 4MP+2MP WizColor Vari-focal Network PT Camera Key Points • Captures a Large Area and Great Details at the Same Time • High-Quality Imaging with 4MP Resolution for Bullet Channel, 2MP for PTZ Channel • Supports 6x Hybrid Zoom for Better Image Quality at Long Distances • Real-Time Communication via Built-In Two-Way Talk • Supports Human and Vehicle Detection • Active Deterrence: Audible and Visual Alarms Can Be Triggered by Certain Events to Drive Away the Target • IP66 & TVS 6000V Protection with Lightning/Surge/Voltage Transient Resistance Sales Enquiry Datasheet
